_comment: Approved wiki sources for the random 'wander' serendipity source (fetch_wiki.py). Grouped by language. Flip 'enabled' to approve a source — only enabled ones are ever drawn from. 'api' is the MediaWiki api.php base; 'namespace' 0 = main/article space. Random pages are uncurated, so enabling a source is an explicit choice about what entropy Ava drinks from.
